meta.titulo: Stunt Drive School — Driving school for film stunt performers
meta.descripcion: Official precision driving school for film and commercial stunt performers: car chases, drifting, two-wheel driving, camera car tracking and motorbikes. Courses in Castellolí (Barcelona).

hero.alt: White car driving through a huge burst of flame on the track
hero.eyebrow2: Stunt driving for film and commercials
hero.sub: Techniques used only in film and TV: car chases, smuggler runs, two-wheel driving, drifting and much more. Learn from stunt drivers who do it on set.

experiencia.lead: You learn on the track, behind the wheel, with stunt drivers who work on real film sets.
experiencia.f1: Hands-on coaching. Your instructor corrects you on every run, from outside the car and from the passenger seat.
experiencia.f2: School cars and bikes. Track-prepared, so you only have to think about technique.
experiencia.f3: Small groups. More time at the wheel, less time waiting your turn.
experiencia.f4: FAST Parcmotor. A closed circuit in Castellolí with room to practise every manoeuvre.

fechas.intro: Small groups at the FAST Parcmotor circuit in Castellolí. If the course you want isn't listed, drop us a line and we'll let you know when it's next on.

avisos.texto: Leave your details and we'll get in touch when we open dates for the courses you're interested in. No commitment.
avisos.consentimiento: I have read and accept the privacy policy.

cursos.intro: Level-based training in cars and on motorbikes. Start with precision, then specialise in the technique each scene calls for.
cursos.nota: The organisers reserve the right to change dates or course content due to internal needs or bad weather.

equipo.intro: Two working stunt professionals who have spent years coordinating and shooting driving scenes for film and commercials, in Spain and abroad.
equipo.fotoAlt: Oriol Tarrida and Jordi Nebot next to one of the school's cars at the circuit
equipo.oriolBio: CEO of Stunts Tarrida Team and an established stunt performer. His speciality: pushing vehicles to the limit in front of the camera. Now he's putting all that experience within your reach.
equipo.jordiBio: CEO of TyreAction and Precision Driver. He brings his perspective as an action coordinator and years of international shoots to take technical driving to the next level.

privacidad.quienP: The data controller is TYREACTION, S.L., owner of Stunt Drive School. You can call us or message us on WhatsApp at +34 633 06 36 57.
privacidad.datosH: What data we collect and why
privacidad.datosP: When you join our mailing list we store your name, your email, your phone number if you give it to us and the types of course you're interested in. We only use them to let you know when we open new dates or intakes for our courses. We don't use them for anything else and we don't build profiles.
privacidad.baseH: Why we're allowed to do this
privacidad.baseP: Because you give us your consent by ticking the box on the form. You can withdraw it whenever you like, without giving any reason.
privacidad.plazoP: Until you ask us to remove you. When you do, we delete your data from the list.
privacidad.dondeH: Where it is stored and who can see it
privacidad.dondeP: The data is stored on our own encrypted server in Spain, with no public access. We don't sell it or share it with anyone. To protect the form from automated submissions we use Cloudflare, which processes your IP address for technical purposes to check that you're not a robot; it doesn't receive the rest of your data.
privacidad.derechosP: You can ask us at any time to see your data, correct it, delete it, restrict its use, object to us using it or take it with you. Just write to us at the email above saying what you'd like. If you feel we haven't handled your request properly, you can file a complaint with the Agencia Española de Protección de Datos (Spanish Data Protection Agency).
privacidad.bajaP: Message us on WhatsApp or call us at +34 633 06 36 57 and we'll take you off the list.
